# codigo de paper IPLs Flores 2022 et al., 

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
ratio <- read.csv("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/IPL_NITROGEN/boxplot/20.sat_unsat_table.csv")
#ratio1 <- read.csv("~/Documents/EF_IPL_Processing_new/data_final/21.sat_unsat_table.csv")
ratio$environment = factor(ratio$environment, levels=c('Water_column','Bathyal_sediments','Hadal_sediments'))
data <- data.frame(ratio)
#str(data)
```


```{r, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(data = ratio, aes(x=factor(environment), y=unsat.sat, fill=environment)) + 
   geom_boxplot(position=position_dodge(0.9), outlier.colour = NA)  + 
  geom_smooth(method="gam", span=0.20, se=TRUE, aes(group=unsat.sat, color=unsat.sat)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c( "#999999","peru", "steelblue")) +
  
  ylab("Total Unsaturated/Total saturated ")
  xlab("Environment") 
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
p <- ggplot(ratio,aes(x=environment,y=unsat.sat, fill=environment)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group=environment)) + 
  geom_point(aes(fill=environment),size=2,shape=21,position=position_jitterdodge(0.6)) +
  #geom_smooth(aes(fill=environment), method = "gam") +
    stat_summary(fun.y=mean, geom="point", shape=19, size=2, color="red", fill="black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c( "#999999","#74c476", "#E69F00"))  
p
```

# SURFACE 

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ratio <- read.csv("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/IPL_NITROGEN/boxplot/05.surface_class_sampletype_bound_sat_unsat_ratio.csv")

#ratio <- read.csv("~/Documents/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/IPL_NITROGEN/boxplot/06.subsurface_class_sampletype_bound_sat_unsat_ratio.csv")

ratio$environment = factor(ratio$phase, levels=c('Phase1','Phase2','Phase3','Phase4'))
data <- data.frame(ratio)
#str(data)
```

# SURFACE

```{r, echo=FALSE}
p <- ggplot(ratio,aes(x=phase,y=unsat.sat, fill=phase)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group=phase)) + 
  geom_point(aes(fill=phase),size=2,shape=21,position=position_jitterdodge(0.6)) +
  #geom_smooth(aes(fill=environment), method = "gam") +
    stat_summary(fun.y=mean, geom="point", shape=19, size=2, color="red", fill="black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#B2182B", "#EF8A62", "#67A9CF", "#2166AC"))  
p
```


```{r}
p <- ggplot(ratio, aes(x = phase, y = unsat.sat, fill = phase)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = phase)) + 
  geom_point(aes(fill = phase), size = 2, shape = 21, position = position_jitterdodge(0.6)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 19, size = 2, color = "red", fill = "black") +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "loess", color = "gray", se = FALSE) +  # Línea suavizada
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#B2182B", "#EF8A62", "#67A9CF", "#2166AC"))

p
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggthemes)

p <- ggplot(ratio, aes(x = phase, y = unsat.sat, fill = phase)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = phase)) + 
  geom_point(aes(fill = phase), size = 2, shape = 21, position = position_jitterdodge(0.6)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 19, size = 2, color = "red", fill = "black") +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "loess", color = "blue", se = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#B2182B", "#EF8A62", "#67A9CF", "#2166AC")) +
  theme_minimal() +  # Cambia el tema a fondo blanco
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),        # Elimina las cuadrículas
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA), # Fondo blanco
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),  # Fondo blanco alrededor del gráfico
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1)  # Borde negro alrededor del gráfico
  )

p
```

# Ahora Wilcoxon test (p value < 0.001)
# Ahora vamos agregar la significancia 

```{r}
ratio$phase <- as.factor(ratio$phase)
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(ratio, aes(x = phase, y = unsat.sat, fill = phase)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = phase)) + 
  geom_point(aes(fill = phase), size = 2, shape = 21, position = position_jitterdodge(0.6)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "loess", color = "black", se = FALSE) +  # Asegura el grupo para smooth
  stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "point", shape = 19, size = 2, color = "red", fill = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#B2182B", "#EF8A62", "#67A9CF", "#2166AC")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))
```

```{r}
library(ggpubr)

p <- p + stat_compare_means(
  comparisons = list(c("Phase1", "Phase2"), c("Phase1", "Phase3"), c("Phase1", "Phase4"),
                     c("Phase2", "Phase3"), c("Phase2", "Phase4"), c("Phase3", "Phase4")),
  method = "wilcox.test",
  label = "p.signif"
)


p
```

# Ahora Wilcoxon test (p value < 0.001)

```{r}
ratio1$phase <- as.factor(ratio1$phase)
```

```{r}
q <- ggplot(ratio1, aes(x = phase, y = unsat.sat, fill = phase)) +

  geom_point(aes(fill = phase), size = 2, shape = 21, position = position_jitterdodge(0.6)) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))
```


